subject: Properly account for checking zmalloc_used_memory() (#2263)
reason: The change modifies only src/unit/test_main.c, the C unit-test runner: it adds `test_num++` so the end-of-suite zmalloc_used_memory() leak check is counted in the test totals. It affects test-harness bookkeeping only, compiles into the unit-test binary and not into valkey-server or any tool, and changes no command reply, replication, persistence or cluster behaviour. There is nothing a fuzzer scenario against a running server could exercise.
